name: Battlezone
detail: Identical option-switch and coin-door arrangement; knowing one gets you round the other.

name: Tempest Auxiliary PCB
detail: The Math Box, the high-score EAROM, both POKEYs, the spinner and control-panel inputs and the audio output are on the Auxiliary PCB 037585-01, not this board, which is the Analog Vector-Generator PCB. The two have separate designator grids: A4 here is a 74LS08, A4 there a 74LS191.
